text: APPROVE. The loop body moved into `ProductionPackage` with its checks in the original order (root or non-object, empty name, dev/link, version), each `continue` became `return null`, and the `&&` chain with the `is { Length: > 0 } text` pattern keeps `text` definitely assigned. That drops `ReadPackageLock`'s complexity well below 15 and leaves the helper at about 7, with no apparent compile or nullable warnings. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build it or run the tests.
